== Task == 
This tutorial shows how to get {{TAG|POSCAR}} files containing a super cell from an initially smaller cell.

== Super cells from p4vasp ==

*Open p4vasp by typing ''p4v'' on the terminal.
*Load the primitive cell by clicking on '''File'''&rarr;'''Load system''':
[[File:Fig XAS 1.png|200px]]
*Multiply cell in each direction (enter 3 for each direction) by clicking on '''Edit'''&rarr;'''Multiply Cell''':
[[File:Fig XAS 2.png|250px]]
*Save new system by clicking on '''File'''&rarr;'''Save system as''':
[[File:Fig XAS 3.png|250px]]
